_note: Single source of truth for service prices. The booking app charges from this file (prices sent by the browser are ignored) and scripts/build-pricing.mjs generates the price sections on the website from it. After editing, run: npm run pricing:build. price = whole currency units; null = price on request (shown as 'Get a quote', not sold online). unit = 'each' (qty 1) or a label such as 'per product' (quantity can be changed in the cart).

usStateFees._readme: State filing fees for US LLC formation (USD), added on top of the Basic/Advanced package. Checked against two 2026 fee tables (howtoincorporateforfree.com Oct 2026, fileforms.com Jul 2026); confirm on the state's official site if a fee changes. Each becomes a cart item 'us-state-fee-<code>'. Run `npm run pricing:build` after editing.
